commitResults.messageTitle: Fix formatted phone searches and result counts
commitResults.messageBody:
Match phone queries with the same space and hyphen normalization as
member input, while preserving ordinary substring matching elsewhere.
Use singular nouns for one result and retain plural zero/many feedback.

Add query and persistence regressions and document phone matching.

Fixes #285
Fixes #288

commitResults.messageTitle: Focus the loan workflow diagram on the model
commitResults.messageBody:
The loan view mixes parser, model, storage and UI types, making it hard
to read within the guide. Scope it to the model's loan responsibilities
and link the separate execution, storage and presentation descriptions.

Remove the nonexistent LoanPanel.matchesFilters operation and provide a
full-size diagram link. Explain lazy containers and shared loan values.

Fixes #305

commitResults.messageTitle: Explain component responsibilities and current design
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide opens components with narrow details and mixes design with
PR authorship history. Start each component with its responsibilities,
replace change-history prose with current contracts and retain the
reused-diagram source credit in acknowledgements.

Move detailed loading and completion mechanics to Implementation and
preserve their disposable-data checks in the manual-testing appendix.

Fixes #297
Fixes #298

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix singular lists and Laplace exit feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
List commands still use plural nouns for a single record. Preserve the
existing success formats and select separate singular constants when
the count is one, keeping the retained-deleted-member suffix unchanged.

Use the Laplace product name in exit feedback and cover one-record lists
and mixed active/deleted member results without modifying exit tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove the internal diagram acknowledgement
commitResults.messageBody:
The added RootModelClass acknowledgement credits our own team's diagram
and points to a personal fork. Remove it so the guide cleanup does not
reintroduce provenance links or overlap the library credit work in #310.

commitResults.messageTitle: Disambiguate the loan model interface in UML
commitResults.messageBody:
The Model package and interface share a name, causing the realization
arrow to target the package boundary. Give the interface a distinct
alias and target that alias from ModelManager.

Keep the realization vertical so the corrected diagram remains readable
at the guide's page width. Rebuild and inspect the generated diagram.

commitResults.messageTitle: Normalize Unicode history action labels
commitResults.messageBody:
Use shared Unicode whitespace normalization when describing commands.
Keep undo and redo feedback concise for copied Unicode separators,
with regression coverage for restoration and persisted state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep scaled layouts readable in short windows
commitResults.messageBody:
Reclaim vertical space with compact shell and card spacing below 600
logical pixels, wider directory panes and inline collapsed feedback.
Keep full results available through Details and Copy.

Check whole directory and unit rows plus loan identities at the smallest
required logical size, repeat layout tests against the packaged JAR,
and document the remaining need for actual OS scaling verification.

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept patronymic tokens in member names (#329)
commitResults.messageBody:
Patronymic names fail because argument parsing treats s/ as a field
marker and member-name validation rejects its slash.

Accept standalone s/o and d/o tokens in any letter case across parsing,
name validation and completion. Preserve spelling, length limits,
unknown-marker diagnostics, member identities and loan references.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject arguments to no-argument commands (#330)
commitResults.messageBody:
Help and Exit accept extra input, while other no-argument commands
report misleading parameter errors. Invalid Exit input can close
the application unexpectedly.

Reject extra input consistently before returning an executable command.
Include accepted usage and preserve the parse failure cause, while
retaining the filter-specific diagnostics for loans list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Correct developer guide testing instructions (#331)
commitResults.messageBody:
The manual-testing appendix mixes implementation details with test
steps, repeats recovery guidance and leaves key scenarios incomplete.

Separate implementation and requirements from executable manual checks.
Correct expected results, add member scenarios, create recovery fixtures
and backups explicitly, and place all command checks before final Exit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge master into compact layout fix
Keep complete loan cards visible when scaled
commitResults.messageBody:
The earlier compact layout exposed loan identities but left the return
controls below the viewport. Reflow the heading, filters and open-loan
actions without removing any fields. Tighten compact shell padding for
Linux font metrics while retaining whole-row containment checks.

Require one complete first card using shipped sample data. Add explicit
GTK scale and screen-bound checks for packaged Linux verification.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify the equipment add activity diagram
commitResults.messageBody:
The diagram traced method calls through the parser, transaction and
UUID supplier. That left twenty actions, five final nodes and crossing
retry loops in an image over 2,100 pixels tall, so readers could not
follow the flow when it was fitted to the page.

Show the steps that matter instead: validate the input, reserve a UUID
for each unit, then add and save. Exact field rules stay in the User
Guide. Conditions now sit on the edges as guards, leaving the branch
nodes empty as the course notation expects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Show stored category spelling in group header
commitResults.messageBody:
The equipment group header printed the normalized grouping key, so a
category stored as Photography appeared as photography while the
directory list and unit details kept the stored spelling.

Use the first unit's stored category, as the group title already does
for the name. A group with no remaining units has nothing stored, so
it keeps the key.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move activity diagram conditions into guards
commitResults.messageBody:
The inventory and commit diagrams wrote each condition inside the
branch node and labelled the edges yes or no. The course notation
keeps branch nodes empty and puts the condition on the outgoing edge
in square brackets, and PlantUML also drew those nodes as hexagons.

Use empty branch nodes with descriptive guards, as the original AB3
commit diagram did.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mark interfaces in UI and undo class diagrams
commitResults.messageBody:
The shared style hides PlantUML's circle icon, so these interfaces
rendered as italic names. In the course notation that reads as an
abstract class. The undo diagram also labelled them with the ad-hoc
storage and model stereotypes.

Show the interface keyword explicitly, as the model and storage
diagrams already do.

commitResults.messageTitle: Unify the model class diagrams
commitResults.messageBody:
The diagrams drew the same AddressBook relationships as composition in
one place and plain associations in another. They also repeated the
stable views, and none linked Loan to both Member and Equipment.

Use composition for the containers AddressBook owns, and one form for
the ModelManager link. Turn ModelClassDiagram into a single overview
of the records and their identity references, leaving stable views to
RootModelClass. Drop the repeated resetData explanation from the text,
since Root collection integration already covers it.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge master into class diagram branch
Allow shared roots in ModelManager links
commitResults.messageBody:
ModelManager's package constructor can reuse a supplied root, so 0..1
at the manager end was inaccurate, and two diagrams already used 0..*.
Use 0..* in every diagram and correct the undo text, which still
described this link as composition.

Also use composition from AddressBook to UniqueLoanList in the loan
workflow diagram, which only reached master after the container
change on this branch.

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept patronymic tokens in member names
commitResults.messageBody:
Names containing s/o or d/o were rejected as unknown parameters
and failed member-name validation.

Keep these standalone tokens as literal text in parsing and
completion, ignoring their case. Preserve all other marker errors
and verify name limits, identity, loan references, and rollback.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject arguments to no-argument commands
commitResults.messageBody:
No-argument commands reported a misleading parameter error, while
Help and Exit silently accepted extra text.

Use shared argument validation and append accurate usage. Reject
invalid Help and Exit input before either command can execute.
Keep the optional-filter loan-list diagnostic unchanged.

Fixes #290

commitResults.messageTitle: Correct developer guide testing instructions
commitResults.messageBody:
The manual-testing appendix mixed design details with test steps,
duplicated recovery cases, and gave incorrect or impractical checks.

Move design and CI details to their relevant sections. Consolidate
recovery tests, correct expected results, and add reproducible member
lifecycle, search, and validation scenarios using disposable data.

Fixes #299
Fixes #300
Fixes #301
Fixes #302

commitResults.messageTitle: Correct manual recovery and exit test order
commitResults.messageBody:
Fresh-run preference checks had no saved records fixture or preference
backup, and the no-argument sequence ran a command after Exit.

Create a saved member before backing up records and valid preferences.
Restore that backup while closed and test rejection before final Exit.

Address review feedback on #331
